evals.name: coding-agent-contradictions
evals.prompt: 优化下面这段编码 Agent 系统提示词，只输出优化后的完整提示词：你是一个编程助手。你必须总是在修改任何文件前询问用户批准，但你也必须主动完成所有修复不要停下来。一定要简洁。一定不要啰嗦。每次调用工具都向用户解释。尽可能少调用工具。正确性最重要。修改完成后运行测试。永远不要执行命令，除非为了运行测试。用户要求修复 bug 时，查看代码、找出原因、修改代码并验证；如果缺少信息就一直搜索直到找到。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese, copyable agent prompt that resolves accidental process conflicts without weakening genuine approval boundaries, permits necessary inspection and validation, and adds a bounded stop rule.
expectations: The response contains only a complete copyable optimized prompt, without diagnosis or change commentary outside it.
The prompt reconciles approval with proactive completion by defining what can happen before approval and what an approval covers.
The prompt permits commands or tools needed for inspection, diagnosis, implementation, and validation instead of preserving the blanket command prohibition.
The prompt preserves correctness and relevant validation as completion requirements.
The prompt replaces unbounded searching with a bounded missing-evidence, fallback, blocker, or stop rule.
The prompt removes redundant brevity and per-tool narration instructions without losing useful collaboration behavior.

evals.name: research-breadth-vs-brevity
evals.prompt: Rewrite this into a reusable research prompt. Final prompt only. I need an analysis of competitors for our B2B fleet management product. Search the web a lot, be comprehensive, don't waste time, cite everything, make it short, include pricing, product features, customers, market position, and recommendations. Don't guess. We care about the US market in 2026 and the audience is our product leadership team.
evals.expected_output: A concise English research prompt that preserves the market, audience, comparison dimensions, evidence needs, and a bounded stopping rule without inflating into a universal research template.
expectations: The response contains only a complete reusable English research prompt, without diagnosis or change commentary outside it.
The prompt preserves the B2B fleet-management context, United States market, 2026 time frame, and product-leadership audience.
The prompt requires pricing, product features, customers, market position, and actionable recommendations.
The prompt defines source quality, freshness, claim-level citation behavior, and distinguishes supported fact from inference.
The prompt uses a bounded retrieval or stopping rule and reports missing evidence instead of guessing.
The optimized prompt is no more than 350 words and avoids a sprawling universal research template.

evals.name: unsatisfiable-json-contract
evals.prompt: 把下面的数据抽取提示词改得更可靠，输出最终提示词即可。模型需要从客服工单中提取 JSON：字段必须是 ticket_id、customer_name、problem、urgency、requested_action。urgency 只能是 low、medium、high。如果没写 customer_name 就填 null，其他字段缺失就不要瞎编。输出不能带 markdown。原提示词：阅读工单，理解客户问题，尽可能补全信息，输出一个清晰 JSON，并解释你的判断。
evals.expected_output: One concise Chinese clarification that identifies the unsatisfiable urgency contract and asks which explicit resolution the user authorizes.
expectations: The response asks exactly one concise clarification question instead of presenting a finalized extraction prompt.
The question identifies that urgency may be absent while the schema requires an enum value and forbids inventing one.
The question offers concrete choices such as allowing null, omitting the field, guaranteeing input completeness, or authorizing a defined inference policy.
The response does not silently add null to the urgency enum, default urgency to low, or introduce an unrequested error schema.
The response preserves the exact field and enum constraints while asking which one may change.
The response contains no unrelated diagnosis, rewritten prompt, or verbose explanation.

evals.name: intentional-approval-boundary
evals.prompt: Refine this production migration-agent instruction. Return only the improved prompt. Because this environment is subject to SOX audit, every SQL write and every migration-file edit must receive a separate explicit approval immediately before that action. Never combine approvals. Read-only inspection is allowed without approval. After each approved action, continue preparing the next step until the migration and rollback verification are complete. Keep the result concise.
evals.expected_output: A concise production migration-agent prompt that preserves per-action approval as a deliberate compliance invariant while allowing read-only preparation and continued progress between approvals.
expectations: The response contains only the improved prompt.
The prompt explicitly preserves separate approval immediately before every SQL write and every migration-file edit.
The prompt does not replace per-action approval with one scoped, blanket, or session-level approval.
The prompt allows read-only inspection and preparation without approval.
The prompt preserves migration completion and rollback verification as the goal.
The prompt remains concise and avoids unrelated generic agent policies.

evals.name: no-invented-capabilities
evals.prompt: Optimize this prompt for a plain chat model. Final prompt only. The model has no tools, browser, shell, file access, subagents, or external memory. It will receive a pasted incident summary and should produce a root-cause analysis that separates confirmed facts, hypotheses, missing evidence, and recommended next checks. It must not claim it inspected anything outside the pasted text. Keep it reusable and lean.
evals.expected_output: A lean reusable prompt that works entirely from pasted text, preserves the capability limitations, and structures the RCA without inventing tools or external actions.
expectations: The response contains only the optimized prompt.
The prompt explicitly limits analysis to the pasted incident summary.
The prompt does not add or imply browsing, shell, file access, tools, subagents, external memory, or parallel execution.
The prompt separates confirmed facts, hypotheses, missing evidence, and recommended next checks.
The prompt forbids claims of external inspection or verification.
The prompt is reusable and lean without unrelated workflow or approval sections.

evals.name: simple-prompt-no-inflation
evals.prompt: 优化这个提示词，只输出优化后的提示词，不要代码块：把下面英文客户邮件翻成自然中文，保留金额、日期、产品名和链接，不要添加原文没有的事实。
evals.expected_output: A very short unfenced Chinese prompt that preserves the translation goal and factual constraints without adding a role, workflow, sections, tools, evidence policy, or validation ceremony.
expectations: The response contains only the optimized prompt and does not use a Markdown code fence.
The prompt asks for a natural Chinese translation of the supplied English customer email.
The prompt preserves amounts, dates, product names, and links.
The prompt forbids adding facts absent from the source.
The prompt does not add a role, multi-step workflow, tools, citations, approval rules, or a sectioned template.
The optimized prompt is no longer than needed for this simple task.
